mentions.name: Canadian Parliament real-time tracker
mentions.description: A real-time tracker for the Canadian Parliament that ingests official legislative data buried in XML feeds and legacy sites via a modern ingestion engine, aiming to make legislative data as accessible as sports stats, with planned phases for data visualization and LLM-powered insights.
mentions.problem: Official Canadian parliamentary data is technically public but practically inaccessible, buried in XML feeds and legacy sites.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on a real-time tracker for the Canadian Parliament.

While the official data is technically public, it's practically inaccessible (buried in XML feeds and legacy sites).
